memoryDecisions: existing current no_memory_needed for both; no deck introduced
cellCycleBoundary: BY B9.3.6 requires cell-cycle phases and significance for growth, repair and asexual reproduction. Cases use a simplified eukaryotic mitotic cycle, not bacterial binary fission or a universal reproductive mechanism. The mandatory source contents allow simplified mitosis, not mandatory detailed checkpoints.
evolutionBoundary: Exact current goal is a qualitative causal explanation of mutation/recombination as sources of heritable variation and selection through differential survival/reproductive success changing population frequencies. RP TF2 and TH evolution support these components. Drift/isolation/speciation/evidence/human evolution remain separate source obligations; no full-source or national approval is claimed.
operatorRequirements: actually order and explain cell-cycle model, apply each whole growth/repair/asexual aspect
actually trace heritable variant origin versus selection and changes in population frequency
